summary: None of TV's five Layout Editor drafting aids exists in VV: Draft mode (K, 26__System__DraftMode), the Drawing Grid (F6/F7, 27), Object Snap (F3, 28, which also holds the viewport carry and the Ctrl+click move anchor), Ortho (F8, 32) and the Drawing Axes (F9, 33). That is 31 TV-only files, 8,752 lines, written v2.107-v2.149 (21-22 Sep), each with the header 'ValeVision : not yet ported - it waits for Adam's sign-off'. The five folder numbers are free in VV. VV's 30__System__SheetTools/Na__LayoutEditor__Snapping__.js (1.2.0) is the ancestor of TV's object snap, not a rival: TV ported it from VV, took it to 1.5.0, then split it into 11 units in 28__System__ObjectSnap at v2.129 (git 7ab70638) and deleted it. Every VV function maps to a TV unit, except the marker TONE (colour by tool), which TV replaced with colour by target. The new files drop in nearly verbatim, but they import nine names VV does not export yet: Measurements Say, SheetSurface ZOOM_SETTLED_EVENT (the v2.111 zoom settle) and GetSheetChrome, SheetModel IsLayerSelectable, ShapeGeometry Rings/EdgePairs, and three pure leaves (ViewportRotation, VectorTools Curves, ShapeRings). They are also switched on from about 20 hub files that VV holds far behind TV (PointerDrag 1.4.0 vs 1.19.0, Keyboard 1.3.0 vs 1.18.0, Toolbar 1.9.0 vs 1.24.0, KeyMap 1.0.0 vs 1.11.0). The slice needs no transport work: every setting is per-browser localStorage or session-only. Three traps: VV's old marker CSS in Styles__Main__Paper must be deleted with the new stylesheet; TONE imports must be dropped when callers are repointed, or module linking fails; and the DraftGuard, DraftRestore and DrawingDrafts tests cover the browser draft (persistence), not Draft mode. Recommended order: leaves, then seams, then folders, then a one-wave Snapping re-export shim with the CSS swap, then the toggles and keys, and last the carry and the anchor. The anchor waits for Adam's sign-off and for Ctrl-drag copy.

findings.title: Five TV drafting-aid folders are absent from VV's Layout Editor
findings.detail: TV LE has 26__System__DraftMode (4 files), 27__System__DrawingGrid (5), 28__System__ObjectSnap (16), 32__System__OrthoMode (3), 33__System__DrawingAxes (3): 31 files, 8,752 lines, all TV v2.107-v2.149 (21-22 Sep-2026). VV LE has none of them, and the numbers 26/27/28/32/33 are unused in VV (VV LE holds 01,03,05,07,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,50,55,56,57,60,70,80), so the folders can be created with TV's exact names and every later port copies file for file.
findings.recommendation: Create the five folders in VV LE with identical names and numbers and port their files (WP-S04b-03/04/05/06/10/11/12). No renumbering anywhere.
findings.evidence: ls of both LE trees; drift_all.tsv marks all 31 files tv-only; each TV JS header: 'ValeVision : not yet ported - it waits for Adam's sign-off.'

findings.detail: VV 30__System__SheetTools/Na__LayoutEditor__Snapping__.js 1.2.0 (455 lines) equals TV Snapping 1.3.0 (tones). findings.title: Draft mode state leaf (Na__LayoutEditor__DraftMode__State__.js) missing
findings.detail: A leaf with no imports: the session-only Draft flag, CHANGED_EVENT 'na-layouteditor-draft-changed', IsOn and AssignOn. It is a leaf on purpose: Viewport2d, Viewport2d__Frame and Viewport3d read IsOn before booking a raster render, and importing the controller would close a cycle through the sheet surface. Off on every load; never written to a record, the browser draft or localStorage.
